title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
summary_zh: 视频条件世界模型的动态世界探索基准，包含 745 段源视频、6 个评估维度及 24 项子指标，并评测 8 个模型。提出免训练框架 WanderLand，改善源视频动态保真度与重访一致性。
summary_en: A benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds with video-conditioned world models, comprising 745 source videos, 6 evaluation dimensions, and 24 sub-metrics, with evaluations of 8 models. The training-free WanderLand framework improves source-dynamics fidelity and revisit consistency.

title: DIVE: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Interaction with Visual Engagement in Continuous Streams
summary_zh: 面向连续音视频流的全双工交互评测基准，覆盖主动介入、持续参与和交互协调三类场景，包含 6 项任务、525 个评估实例（源自 413 个基础场景）；分别评估回应质量、参与决策与响应时机。
summary_en: A benchmark for full-duplex interaction in continuous audio-video streams, spanning proactive intervention, continuous engagement, and interaction coordination. It comprises 6 tasks and 525 evaluation instances from 413 base scenarios, assessing response quality, participation decisions, and response timing.
contributions_zh: 运行评测实验，按任务差异设计并迭代 judge-model 提示词，交付完整评测提示词。
提出一项任务的数据集改进建议；参与论文写作、科研绘图、校验与润色。
contributions_en: Ran evaluation experiments and developed task-specific judge-model prompts, delivering the complete evaluation prompt set.
Suggested a dataset refinement for one task; contributed to manuscript writing, research figures, and proofreading.
contribution_source: 用户更新的重点素材填写表，读取于2026-10-29

title: MOSAIC: Multi-Policy Sampling and Collaborative Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_zh: 面向视觉–语言–动作模型（VLA）的协同测试时适应（TTA），结合跨策略动作蒸馏（CAD）与策略内轨迹巩固（WTC）。CAD 在 4 个机器人操作基准上将平均成功率从 57.56% 提升至 60.60%；WTC 将平均成功率从 56.00% 提升至 58.91%。
summary_en: Collaborative test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language-action (VLA) models via Cross-Policy Action Distillation (CAD) and Within-Policy Trajectory Consolidation (WTC). Across 4 robotic manipulation benchmarks, CAD raises mean success rate from 57.56% to 60.60%; WTC raises mean success rate from 56.00% to 58.91%.
contributions_zh: 参与实验设计与执行，以及论文写作、科研绘图、校验和润色。
contributions_en: Contributed to experimental design and execution, manuscript writing, research figures, and proofreading.
contribution_source: 用户更新的重点素材填写表，读取于2026-10-29
